extensions.description: Dynamic multi-agent collaboration with 6 negotiated modes

skills.name: Collaborative Problem Solving
skills.description: Analyzes complex tasks and orchestrates Claude + Gemini collaboration using the optimal swarm mode (PARALLEL, SEQUENTIAL, LEAD_SUPPORT, PING_PONG, SPECIALIST, RED_BLUE).
examples: Refactor the authentication module with security review
Analyze this codebase and propose improvements

skills.name: Agent Spawning & Evolution
skills.description: Generates specialized agents for domain-specific tasks via evolutionary brainstorming. Agents persist in workspace/agents/ with BIRTH_CERTIFICATEs.
examples: Create a specialized agent for this FastAPI project
Evolve current agents for better performance

skills.name: Secure Code Execution
skills.description: Executes shell commands and code through validated execution policies. Docker sandboxing is the default isolation path when available; validated host execution is a local-development opt-in.

skills.name: Project Memory & RAG
skills.description: Retrieves relevant project context using BM25S sparse retrieval and optional dense embeddings (LanceDB + sentence-transformers). Tracks success patterns.
examples: What patterns worked best for auth implementations?
Retrieve context about the swarm engine
Search project memory for deployment configurations

skills.name: Multi-Format Document Ingestion
skills.description: Ingests PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, and audio into project memory using IBM Docling. 100% local processing.
examples: Ingest this PDF specification into memory
Add this Excel data to the knowledge base

skills.name: Web Research
skills.description: Searches the web and fetches content for up-to-date information gathering and research tasks.
examples: Find best practices for FastAPI security
Look up the current A2A protocol specification
